fun main() {
    var balance = 1000000
    var month = 0
    var totalInterest = 0
    var totalPaid = 0
    while (balance > 0) {
        month++
        val interest = balance / 100
        val payment = minOf(50000, balance + interest)
        val principal = payment - interest
        balance -= principal
        totalInterest += interest
        totalPaid += payment
        println("month $month: interest=$interest principal=$principal balance=$balance")
    }
    println("total interest: $totalInterest")
    println("total paid: $totalPaid")
}
